notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 is here!
notes.content: [p][/p][h3]Hey degens~ Thanks for making our launch a great one! [/h3][p][/p][p]It's a mix of celebration and enthusiastic bug-extermination over here. Here're the notes from our first patch![/p][p][/p][p]🔎 River had figured out how to hide in the loading screens... but no more! She should now be somewhere on Phoenix Island. This is backwards-compatible with existing saves![/p][p]🔎 Charlie was causing softlocks at the graveyard. We gave him a stern talking-to and he shouldn't anymore. [/p][p]🔎 Fixed colliders in the grocery store. No more visits to aisle null. [/p][p]🔎 Reduced Brittany's love of wieners just enough to prevent an infinite loop. [/p][p]🔎 Quality of Life: Added the spacebar as an option for progressing through dialogue. [/p][p]🔎 Translations: Updated translations to fix several issues in Japanese, Spanish and other languages. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Known Issues:[/b] [/p][p]🔎 Incorrect dialogue speaker in Rayou's introduction. [/p][p][b]🔎[/b] Controller buttons are not responsive in all menus. Hover over a button with the mouse to re-activate them.[/p][p]⚠️ Ooops! Our hotfix came in so hot it burned the credits page! We'll need a Hotfix the Sequel to cool them off.[/p][p][/p][h3]Happy sleuthing![/h3]

tags.bug: 🔎 River had figured out how to hide in the loading screens... but no more! She should now be somewhere on Phoenix Island. This is backwards-compatible with existing saves!
🔎 Charlie was causing softlocks at the graveyard. We gave him a stern talking-to and he shouldn't anymore.
🔎 Fixed colliders in the grocery store. No more visits to aisle null.

tags.balance_change: 🔎 Reduced Brittany's love of wieners just enough to prevent an infinite loop.

tags.feature: 🔎 Quality of Life: Added the spacebar as an option for progressing through dialogue.

tags.bug: 🔎 Translations: Updated translations to fix several issues in Japanese, Spanish and other languages.
